one_liner: Ecommerce platform: free open-source Magento Open Source, or paid enterprise Adobe Commerce (cloud or on-prem).

auth.notes: On-prem/Open Source third-party apps authenticate with OAuth1.0a; admin/customer/integration tokens (bearer) are also issued. Adobe Commerce as a Cloud Service instead uses Adobe IMS OAuth2. Mixed picture depending on deployment/version.

access.notes: Magento Open Source is free/self-hosted with immediate API/integration-token access. Adobe Commerce (paid, cloud) is a separate enterprise-sales product layered on the same API surface.

api.notes: Large REST/GraphQL/SOAP API covering catalog, orders, customers, CMS. Buildability differs sharply between free Open Source and sales-gated Adobe Commerce Cloud tiers; noted as a caveat rather than collapsed into one answer.

verdict.rationale: The free Magento Open Source edition is self-hosted, so a developer must stand up their own instance to get API access; the paid Adobe Commerce Cloud edition is sales-gated.
